description: List current offers (price, shipping, delivery, stock, shop link) for one product from search_products, optionally for one pack (a pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page; it can hold several PZNs, e.g. an original and its reimports), plus the lowest price of the last 90 days. unit_price is the normalized base price (Grundpreis) of the offer: {value, per} in EUR per 1 l, per 1 kg or per piece (per = l, kg, pcs); absent when unknown. Each result carries a disclosure (affiliate links, price source) and, for medicines, a compliance_notice with the statutory German notice. Prices only, from German online shops; no medical advice.

pack_size.description: A pack from search_products: its identity_key when it has one, else its label. A pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page.

name: search_product_offers
title: List offers for a product
